events.title: Merger forms a new provisional local
events.body: Local 149 (Aurora) and Local 582 (Elgin) merged. DOL later characterized the result as a NEW provisional local rather than a continuation, even though OLMS kept file number 18000 and the 1970 establishment date. LIUNA appointed provisional officers under Article VII Section 2(f) of its constitution and a "supervisor" under Article IX Section 7, both effective the same day.

events.title: Trusteeship begins
events.body: LIUNA considered the supervised status a sufficient restriction on the local's autonomy to constitute a trusteeship under the LMRDA, and filed Initial Trusteeship Forms with the Department of Labor.

events.title: Members file a DOL complaint
events.body: Members in good standing filed a complaint with the Department of Labor alleging LIUNA had held the local in trusteeship beyond 18 months, in violation of Title III of the LMRDA. Under 29 U.S.C. 461-66 a trusteeship is presumed valid for 18 months and presumed INVALID after that unless the trustee shows by clear and convincing evidence that it remains necessary.

events.title: LIUNA sets an end date
events.body: LIUNA determined supervision would end no later than June 30, 2016, after the election of delegates to the International Convention.

events.title: Delegate nominations held; supervisor dismissed
events.body: The trusteeship ended in the spring of 2016 when LIUNA dismissed the local's Supervisor. The executive board — selected by the officers of the merged locals, not elected by members — remained in place.

events.title: DOL dismisses the complaint
events.body: DOL agreed the supervision had constituted a trusteeship, but concluded it ended when the Supervisor was dismissed. On the members' argument that the trusteeship persisted because no officers were ELECTED, DOL held that LIUNA's constitution requires installing officers only where officers were removed, and that holding elections in June 2017 fell inside the three-year statutory maximum term. File closed.

events.title: First officer election since the merger
events.body: Two years and eight months after the merged local was formed, members elected officers for the first time.
